context: M26 o9. A parked car on W 31st & Fifth. Prentiss counting cash for the firebug. Teddy opens the passenger door.

lines.speaker: char.vic_prentiss
lines.text: Teddy! Ha! What a night! False alarms. Terrible thing. Nobody's fault.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Your man's two cans are in my lobby. My friend's photograph is in her camera.

lines.speaker: char.vic_prentiss
lines.text: Teddy, Teddy. I'm in the moving business. Moving's healthy. You can't prove—

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: I don't need to prove it, Vic. I need you to never come back to Thirty-First.

lines.speaker: char.vic_prentiss
lines.text: …Can I call you Teddy? No. Okay. Okay.
